cards.back:
An informal word for children. Formal: children.
Bahasa Indonesia: anak-anak
Example: The kids in my class love playing football at break.
cards.say: kids. An informal word for children. Formal: children. The kids in my class love playing football at break.

cards.back:
The formal word for young people.
Bahasa Indonesia: anak-anak
Example: The children walked quietly into the hall for the assembly.
cards.say: children. The formal word for young people. The children walked quietly into the hall for the assembly.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for getting something by paying. Formal: purchase.
Bahasa Indonesia: membeli
Example: We buy our bread from the baker on the corner.
cards.say: buy. The ordinary word for getting something by paying. Formal: purchase. We buy our bread from the baker on the corner.

cards.back:
The formal word for buy.
Bahasa Indonesia: membeli (formal)
Example: Visitors may purchase tickets at the main entrance.
cards.say: purchase. The formal word for buy. Visitors may purchase tickets at the main entrance.

cards.back:
An informal word. Formal: obtain or receive.
Bahasa Indonesia: mendapat
Example: I will get a new notebook from the shop today.
cards.say: get. An informal word. Formal: obtain or receive. I will get a new notebook from the shop today.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to get.
Bahasa Indonesia: memperoleh
Example: You must obtain permission before using the school hall.
cards.say: obtain. A formal word meaning to get. You must obtain permission before using the school hall.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for giving support. Formal: assist.
Bahasa Indonesia: membantu
Example: Please help me carry these boxes to the car.
cards.say: help. The ordinary word for giving support. Formal: assist. Please help me carry these boxes to the car.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to help.
Bahasa Indonesia: membantu (formal)
Example: The librarian will assist you in finding a book.
cards.say: assist. A formal word meaning to help. The librarian will assist you in finding a book.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for requesting information. Formal: enquire.
Bahasa Indonesia: bertanya
Example: I will ask the teacher about the homework.
cards.say: ask. The ordinary word for requesting information. Formal: enquire. I will ask the teacher about the homework.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to ask.
Bahasa Indonesia: menanyakan
Example: Parents may enquire at the office about school fees.
cards.say: enquire. A formal word meaning to ask. Parents may enquire at the office about school fees.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for beginning. Formal: commence.
Bahasa Indonesia: mulai
Example: The lesson will start at nine o'clock in the main hall.
cards.say: start. The ordinary word for beginning. Formal: commence. The lesson will start at nine o'clock in the main hall.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to start.
Bahasa Indonesia: memulai
Example: The ceremony will commence at ten o'clock in the school hall.
cards.say: commence. A formal word meaning to start. The ceremony will commence at ten o'clock in the school hall.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for finishing. Formal: conclude.
Bahasa Indonesia: berakhir
Example: The film will end in about twenty minutes.
cards.say: end. The ordinary word for finishing. Formal: conclude. The film will end in about twenty minutes.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to end.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyimpulkan, mengakhiri
Example: The speaker will conclude with a short poem.
cards.say: conclude. A formal word meaning to end. The speaker will conclude with a short poem.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for requiring something. Formal: require.
Bahasa Indonesia: membutuhkan
Example: We need more chairs for the guests who are coming.
cards.say: need. The ordinary word for requiring something. Formal: require. We need more chairs for the guests who are coming.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to need.
Bahasa Indonesia: memerlukan
Example: All pupils require a signed form to go on the trip.
cards.say: require. A formal word meaning to need. All pupils require a signed form to go on the trip.

cards.back:
The ordinary word for letting people see. Formal: demonstrate.
Bahasa Indonesia: menunjukkan
Example: Show me your drawing of the old castle.
cards.say: show. The ordinary word for letting people see. Formal: demonstrate. Show me your drawing of the old castle.

cards.back:
A formal word meaning to show clearly.
Bahasa Indonesia: memperagakan, menunjukkan dengan jelas
Example: The scientist will demonstrate how a magnet works.
cards.say: demonstrate. A formal word meaning to show clearly. The scientist will demonstrate how a magnet works.

cards.back:
The everyday word for saying you regret something. Formal: apologise.
Bahasa Indonesia: maaf
Example: I am sorry that I forgot your birthday.
cards.say: sorry. The everyday word for saying you regret something. Formal: apologise. I am sorry that I forgot your birthday.

cards.back:
A formal word for saying that you are sorry.
Bahasa Indonesia: meminta maaf
Example: She wrote a letter to apologise for the damage.
cards.say: apologise. A formal word for saying that you are sorry. She wrote a letter to apologise for the damage.

cards.back:
A polite word used when asking someone formally.
Bahasa Indonesia: mohon (dengan hormat)
Example: Kindly remain seated until the show has finished.
cards.say: kindly. A polite word used when asking someone formally. Kindly remain seated until the show has finished.

cards.back:
A polite way to begin a formal letter when you do not know the name.
Bahasa Indonesia: Yth. Bapak atau Ibu
Example: The letter began with Dear Sir or Madam, followed by the request.
cards.say: Dear Sir or Madam. A polite way to begin a formal letter when you do not know the name. The letter began with Dear Sir or Madam, followed by the request.

cards.back:
An informal way to say thank you or goodbye.
Bahasa Indonesia: terima kasih (santai)
Example: Cheers for lending me your pencil, I will return it soon.
cards.say: cheers. An informal way to say thank you or goodbye. Cheers for lending me your pencil, I will return it soon.
